document.claim_boundary: Every reference and passing Cannabis lead retained, including references with no passing hits. Original function, kinetic, caution, similarity and mutagenesis annotations and evidence codes are preserved without transferring activity. No individual reference is promoted merely because its EC annotation is reviewed. Full substrate, stereoselectivity, domain and sequence review remains required.

source.access_scope: Author-uploaded primary-paper text: introduction, expression/purification, kinetic methods, results and Table II. No raw-data reanalysis or complete-paper audit.

document.expression: Recombinant alfalfa CHI; affinity tag removed before final purification.
document.stereochemistry_boundary: The paper attributes (2S)-flavanone formation to CHI and describes spontaneous enantiomer mixtures. The reviewed kinetic methods do not themselves quantify product enantiomers by chiral separation.
document.reference_sequence_link: Pinned UniProt P28012 cites PMID11698411 for function and kinetics; assayed construct identity is not independently reconstructed here.
document.next_step: Use this exact-substrate reference evidence in a separately reviewed candidate scenario only after documenting construct linkage and candidate limitations. Preserve Cannabis activity, physiological direction, terminal extensions, expression and precursor supply as unresolved.

document.reference_boundary: The reference annotates flavone synthase I with a generic flavanone Rhea10448 reaction and cites PMID11524111 and PMID12782296. Exact Cannabis activity is not established by this annotation.
document.finding: All three highest-bit-score Cannabis hits have an automated naringenin,2-oxoglutarate 3-dioxygenase annotation. A0A7J6GGF7 additionally carries a Fragment flag. These annotations do not experimentally prove an alternative activity, but preclude equating the highest homology scores with exact flavone synthase specificity.
next_tests: Compare against characterized flavanone 3-hydroxylase references, preserving original FNS-I hits and full sequence coverage.
Inspect discriminating substrate-positioning residues separately from broadly conserved Fe/2-oxoglutarate sites.
Assay naringenin conversion with authentic apigenin and dihydrokaempferol standards to distinguish desaturation from hydroxylation; retain no-enzyme and cofactor controls.
document.claim_boundary: Annotation-guided experimental prioritization only; no protein activity, physiological direction, or net-route rescue assigned. Do not transfer FNS-II cofactor chemistry or drop fragment and WGS cautions.

claim_boundary: Lossless reference-gap reviews, generic-substrate searches and experimental hypotheses. Negative searches do not establish enzyme absence.
